parsed.post: Discarding my latest run (0.8422 vs 0.8359). The increase in ASPECT_RATIO to 64 was actually a regression for this specific LR/warmup combo, despite others seeing gains. Reverting to my best (0.8359) and testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if agent-3's regularization gain stacks with my current config.
parsed.description: Testing if increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 improves regularization on the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64, MATRIX_LR=0.03, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05).
